text.tspan: Background processor queues are independent of workers.type.
Includes scheduler: one CronJob; FLOW_SCHEDULER_SEGMENTS controls queued dispatch jobs.
processorDeployments.enabled and scheduler.enabled independently select Deployments and CronJobs.
rabbitmq.topology.enabled independently selects the queue assertion hook.
Database connections: LANDLORD_DB_* and TENANT_DB_* / TENANT_DB_*_{id}.
Database connections: LANDLORD_DB_* and TENANT_DB_* / TENANT_DB_*_{id}.
One worker per service key in workers.microservices.
Database connections: LANDLORD_DB_* and TENANT_DB_* / TENANT_DB_*_{id}.
Monocore Go worker. RabbitMQ topology asserted at startup via topology.yaml.
Optional workers.mono.serviceMonitor.enabled: one ServiceMonitor per worker namespace, metrics :8081.
Database connections: DB_LANDLORD_* and DB_TENANT_* / DB_TENANT_{id}_*.
Tenant registry selects the schema and server; company queue does not select a database.
topology + store Secret in selected namespaces
